# Kenney Nature Kit (CC0)

- Official source: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- Official ZIP URL: https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/nature-kit/37ac38a37b-1677698939/kenney_nature-kit.zip
- Pack version: 2.1. Archive SHA-256: `FA7974A0D342BFE63C38664BA9F8EC1A4AAB8EA25F099BDC56870E33588C4D9D`.
- License: CC0; the original package `License.txt` is retained at this directory root.
- Selected Unity-readable FBX models are under `Models/FBX format/`. Their materials are included in each FBX as colored diffuse material assignments; inspected samples do not reference external image textures.
- Selected groups: pine/oak/dark trees, rocks/stones, bushes/grass/moss, and damaged stone columns/statue pieces.
- Raw ZIP and full extraction remain in the ignored `Prototypes/VC5PvE/Downloads/` folder.
- Raw mesh bounds are large: selected pine trees are about 12-19 units high, rocks span about 7-10 units, and the damaged column is 7 units high. On an 8x8 battlefield, try scale 0.15-0.25 for trees/rocks and 0.25-0.35 for columns, then align to the actual tile spacing.
